description.value: The study investigated whether intrauterine growth restriction affects brain responses to palatable foods and whether serum DHA moderates brain and behavioral responses.

spans.text: The goal of the present study was to investigate whether intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) affects brain responses to palatable foods and whether docosahexaenoic acid (DHA, an omega-3 fatty acid that is a primary structural component of the human brain) serum levels moderate the association between IUGR and brain and behavioral responses to palatable foods.
